text:
You're not unlucky in love. You're addicted to chaos.

It's 2 a.m. She's ignoring your texts. You're anxious, checking your phone every 30 seconds. And it feels like love.

It isn't. It's the chaos pull. You were wired early to read tension as closeness.

So the calm woman texts back on time, means what she says, and you leave.

You're not rejecting boring women. You're rejecting safe ones.

Fix it today. Give the steady one 30 real days before you walk.
caption:
Most men waste years chasing a better type in dating. Real mindset shift: your type IS your wound. Self improvement means fixing the attraction, not the selection.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#discipline #selfimprovement #mindset #datingpsychology #men
